examples.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
examples.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of $d_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14080856/assets/80c7234f95b4814f64435f32fbd627fabbd0564d7d2f97f69c003c644d96663e.png)

So, the minor is 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14080856/assets/d4b6ca5c1dad2c83a0f7d76f82099645fb1cfb2db3fb7c552f6b8b9a95684b42.png)

Now, the cofactor of $d_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{23} & =(-1)^{2+3}{M}_{23} \\  & =-{M}_{23} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & -6 \\ 6 & 0 & 9 \\ 5 & 4 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{12}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & 1 & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{12}$, we remove the $1$st row and $2$nd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 0 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 3 & ∗ & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & ∗ & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & ∗ & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{12}=|\begin{aligned}3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$
